{{Quote|We taught these people the 'by-the-book' method of starfighter combat. Young Pash read our datamanuals, and then threw them away and wrote his own.|Gola Chall|<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Gola Chall''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and became a highly successful mole at the Empire's [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]]. Chall observed young cadet [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]], who had enrolled under a false name with the intention of leading others in defecting to the Rebels.
